Prologue:
Heaven was dark and earth was yellow; the cosmos was vast and wild.
Since ancient times the Way and the demonic could never coexist. The world may hold the Way to be righteous, yet the struggle between the Way and the demons has never ceased.
Why, if the Way is righteous, have the demons never been wiped out? Because what makes us righteous or wicked is the heart!
As the saying goes:
The Way is not the Way, the demon is not the demon - good and evil lie in the human heart!
In the martial world there is no one with ears who has not heard the name of Master Wuji, and no one with eyes who does not long to see Master Wuji's peerless grace and matchless skill.
For everyone knows that no maiden alive can resist Master Wuji's faintest smile, and no hero alive can withstand Master Wuji's lightest sword stroke!
Everyone believes that Master Wuji's sword can take an enemy general's head from the midst of a million soldiers, or split a single hair in two - while his smile can break a maiden's heart.
On the night of March 28, as agreed, Wuji met the great archfiend who then plagued the mortal world - the Crimson Demon - for a duel to the death before Demon Cave on Mt. Sanqing.
After the duel Wuji returned wounded, and the Crimson Demon vanished without a trace. No one knows how the duel ended.
Twenty years later...
Little butterfly, don't run away...
Little butterfly, don't run away...
Little butterfly, come on out...
Little butterfly...? Where did you go??
Brother, so this is where you are! Master couldn't find you, and he's raging up in Wuji Tower. Hurry over and see him!
Okay, you go ahead. I'll be right there.
Huh, where did my little butterfly go??
I'd better go see Master first.
Wuji: Qingfeng, your master is over here...
Master--
Brother Liu, snap out of it! He's a demon now!

Haha... Qingfeng, thank... you... My inner demon... is shattered. Put the... Chaos Urn in the heart of the Primal Demonbane Array in Demon... Demon Cave. It will seal every monster of the Myriad Demon Metamorphosis. Now I can... rest...
Wuji is at peace at last.
I'd better go get the Demonbane Sword first!
Off to see Master.
Finally I get to leave the mountain! Haha...
This place is huge. I'd better be careful or I'll get lost.
The scenery at Sanqing Hall really is first-rate.
So serene and otherworldly. A true holy ground of the Taoists.
They say the immortals here really listen. Every prayer gets answered.
They say Taoist Wuji is an immortal reborn. Now that I've seen him, he truly looks the part.
I hear the gate of Mt. Sanqing was carved by a master craftsman. It really is something special.
With surroundings this lovely, living here must add years to your life.
The world tends only its hearth smoke; I drift out of the mists beyond the dust. Though this body still belongs to the mortal world, my heart has no care for earthly things...
Your disciple greets you, Master. You summoned me in a hurry - what are your orders?
Hmph &$#! Playing around from dawn to dusk! You came second-to-last in the last tournament, and you still won't train properly. All you're good for is embarrassing me.
Master, I wasn't playing! I was practicing a kung fu style I invented myself. Here, let me show you...
All right, all right. Listen. I've been reading the heavens, and an evil aura is shrouding the land below the mountain - and it's growing thicker. I was going to send you down to take a look.
Great! I'll set off right away.
Listen. The way you are now, you'd only embarrass me down there. Go to Demon Cave on the back mountain and retrieve the Demonbane Sword. Only then may you leave the mountain.

To get the Demonbane Sword you must pass three trials. First, open the Puzzle Door where the sword is kept. Second, defeat the Swordwarden. Third, dodge the falling rocks. It's time you got some real training. Go.
May I ask, Master, how do I pass these three trials?
That's for you to figure out.
Yes, Master.
Go. Come back to me once you have the sword.
Yes, Master.
Master, I've brought back the sword.
Heh heh, I fully expected you'd get it! Well? You're not hurt, are you?
When I pulled out the sword, the whole mountain shook. It felt like something big happened. And on my way out of the cave a rock smashed my hand.
Oh? Go get that bandaged, then. Leave the sword here with me.
Handed the Demonbane Sword over to Wuji.
Go and pack, then head down the mountain. Remember: to slay demons and defend the Way is your duty. Always keep the people of the world in your heart.
Yes, Master.
Go and pack, then head down the mountain.
Yes, Master.
Master, I went down to investigate. It turned out a half-man, half-snake monster was wreaking havoc in Heartsease village. I've destroyed it, but some villagers were still killed or hurt.
Good timing. Your Uncle Chongxu just sent word by carrier pigeon: a horde of demons is attacking Mt. Zhong, and he's asking for help.
Then I'll make another trip.
You've been seasoned down there, so you should manage. I must stay and hold the fort here, in case it's a ploy to lure me away.
It's a long road. Rest a little before you go.
Yes.
Go.
There's quite a selection of good medicine here.
You rest a while. HP restored.
Had a good rest, feeling great. Time to head out.
I'd better go see Master first. I can play later.
Ow, my hand hurts. Good thing I'm fast on my feet, or I'd have been a goner for sure.
Whoa, it caved in again! Terrifying. Back to Master.
Truly a fine sword! Now I can report to Master and head down the mountain.
This Swordwarden really is tough. I almost didn't beat him.
Fine sword!
Something feels off... What's that noise???
Swordwarden: Who dares lay a hand on the Demonbane Sword?
Oops, I almost forgot about the Swordwarden.
And who are you?
Enough talk - take this!
Swordwarden: Kid, what are you back here for? I never accepted losing to you last time. This time I'll beat you without any helpers.
Truce
Bring it on
Demons are plaguing the land right now. Dealing with them comes first.
Swordwarden: Fine. Today you go slay your demons, and we'll have our rematch another day.
Swordwarden: Sigh, the young really are to be feared! I can't believe I lost again. Oh well, oh well... how humiliating. I'm off!
The Chaos Urn is in place.
The demons vanish at once.
Years later...
Taoist: Reporting, Brother Sect Head! I've found the spot with the most crickets and butterflies.
Oh! Take me there, quick.
Taoist: Yes, sir.
Your son's this big already and all you do is play! You don't act like a father one bit!
Yikes! The old lady's back! Quick, let's run, or she'll nag me until my teeth explode!
